research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Forus Health is engaged in developing devices such as a toroidal source of illumination and an annular light source device for neonatal fundus cameras, both aimed at enhancing retinal imaging. Their research also includes an integrated apparatus for visual function testing, a self-correcting objective refractometry system, and a portable retinal imaging system for preterm infants. These efforts focus on improving detection and assessment of visual impairments and retinal conditions.

overview_description.description: Forus Health is an innovation-driven technology company headquartered in Bangalore and was founded by passionate technocrats in 2010. about_short_description.short_description: Forus Health is a provider of preventive healthcare services to eradicate avoidable blindness.

product.name: 3nethra classic+
product.description: A non-mydriatic digital fundus camera for capturing high-resolution images of the posterior and anterior eye segments for ocular and systemic health screening.

product.name: FH-POISE™ Insights
product.description: An AI solution that analyzes retinal and ophthalmic images to identify indicators of ocular and systemic diseases and generate clinical decision-support reports.

product.name: FH TeleCare
product.description: A secure, integrated eye-care platform for patient management, diagnostic image review, AI-assisted analysis, teleconsultation, optometry workflows, and remote follow-up.

product.name: 3nethra neo HD FA
product.description: A portable mydriatic wide-field retinal imaging system for newborns that captures high-resolution color and fluorescein angiography images, including up to a 150-degree retinal field.

product.name: 3nethra neo
product.description: A portable neonatal retinal imaging camera for capturing wide-field images of newborns’ posterior and anterior eye segments, particularly for retinopathy of prematurity screening.

product.name: 3nethra pico
product.description: A portable handheld retinal and anterior-segment imaging system for capturing ocular images in clinics, screening programs, and outreach settings.
